newsitem.title: USA: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls.
newsitem.headline: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls.

text.p: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls as of 0810 CDT.
LIVE CATTLE - Steady to up 0.100 cent. Carryover seen after firm live trade Wednesday. Upcoming cattle-on-feed may limit trade.
FEEDER CATTLE - Steady to up 0.200 cent. Lower corn futures call should prompt carryover demand.
LEAN HOGS - Steady to off 0.100 cent. Weak cash markets seen pressing August but disount should support October.
PORK BELLIES - Up 0.100 to off 0.100 cent. Firm cash and no deliveries supportive to August, February technically weak.
